networks.description: Building-materials prices for Ilara Junction, Lagos State: cement, reinforcement bar and blocks, with minimum order and delivery window, answered by a single price desk. Representative demonstration dealer.
sample_queries: What does a bag of Dangote cement cost?

peer_policy.note: Ilara Depot calls no peers. It answers its own price book only.

disclosure.note: Ilara Depot is not a real business and Ilara Junction is an invented town. Prices are drawn from dated published Nigerian market reporting, quoted as at 20 November 2026, and are not live inventory. Nothing here can be bought.
